note: Public roadmap data. Phase weights = planned months; overall = weighted average of the phases.

phases.name: Pre-production
phases.summary: The plan, the art style, the engine and the first characters

phases.name: Prototype
phases.summary: Movement kit, first guns, a test island and the first 2-player match

phases.name: Vertical slice
phases.summary: A full match against bots, polished regions, the storm and the first closed playtest

phases.name: Alpha
phases.summary: The whole island finished, more weapons and characters, 24-40 player online matches

phases.name: Beta / Playtest
phases.summary: Open Steam playtests, balance, anti-cheat and performance

phases.name: Early Access
phases.summary: Launch: Solo Royale with 6 characters and 8 weapons

areas.name: Movement
areas.detail: Sprint, slide, slide hopping, mantle, hurdle, vault through windows, wall kick, lean, landings and a punch all work. Next: smoother climbing animations and per-gun moves
areas.short: Sprint, slide hops, mantle, hurdle, window vaults, wall kick, lean and a punch

areas.name: Weapons
areas.detail: 4 guns you can play: Facet AR, Breaker shotgun, Hornet SMG and Sidearm, with 5 rarities and 21 camos, bullet holes and new muzzle sparks. Next: new gun sounds and tracers
areas.short: 4 guns, 5 rarities, 21 camos, bullet holes and muzzle sparks

areas.name: Matches and bots
areas.detail: Every match starts on a spawn island: practise, pick your drop, walk through a portal. Then loot, fight 23 bots, and quests while you play. Next: the storm
areas.short: Spawn island, portal drop, 23 bots and quests in every match

areas.name: Shatter Isle
areas.detail: A 2 km island with 8 regions, furnished houses, 288 doors you can lock or bash open and 1,000+ windows that break. Next: a detail pass on each region
areas.short: 2 km, 8 regions, 288 doors and 1,000+ breakable windows

areas.name: Characters
areas.detail: Phantom is playable in 4 colourways, with a scarf that swings as you move. Next: the other 5 characters
areas.short: Phantom playable in 4 colourways; 5 more to come

areas.name: Menus and settings
areas.detail: Start-up logos, title, main menu, Locker, full settings, loading screen, new pause menu, full map with markers and pings. Next: settings polish
areas.short: Main menu, Locker, full settings, pause menu, full map + pings

areas.name: Community
areas.detail: The Discord server is open. Next: the closed playtest

recent.title: First full match
recent.text: You and 23 bots on Shatter Isle, everyone starting with a sidearm and looting the towns. Bots loot, fight and push, and a match plays out in about 12-15 minutes.

recent.title: Weapon camos and the Locker
recent.text: 21 camos in 3 colours each, on every gun. Preview and equip them in the Locker; everyone in the match sees your pick.

recent.title: Vault through windows
recent.text: Jump at a window and you go straight through, glass and all. It shatters into faceted shards.

recent.title: Bigger, busier towns
recent.text: Street grids and about 118 new houses, every one furnished and full of loot.

recent.title: Meet Phantom
recent.text: The first character: four colourways, a data scarf and faceted gauntlets.
